health.irBeatNote: Bako-Bewele sustained a complete tear of his right patellar tendon in the Packers' Week 2 overtime win over the Jets. The right tackle is out for the season and has thus been placed on injured reserve. Laken Tomlinson is the new reserve offensive lineman for the team, and Anthony Belton is expected to be the starting right tackle for the remainder of the 2026 season.

health.shortComment: Franklin (shin) is inactive for Wednesday's game against the Rams, Mike Spofford of the Packers' official site reports.
health.longComment: Franklin drew the questionable tag for Wednesday's game following three consecutive limited practices. However, the veteran linebacker will end up missing a fifth consecutive game due to a hairline fracture in his shin that he suffered during a practice session in late October, so Ty'Ron Hopper will continue to operate in an elevated role on defense. Franklin's next opportunity to play is Week 13 against the Saints on Sunday, Dec. 6.
factors: Officially ruled Out on weekly game status report
health.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (9th NFL season, 99% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
